messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Mixed-integer nonlinear programming with big-M area lower-bound constraints

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration for maximizing the minimum triangle area in the unit square is a signed-permutation orbit of the two-generator group producing the representative point set {(0,0), (1,1), (1/2,1/2), (1/2,0), (0,1/2), (1,1/2), (1/2,1), (1/4,1/4), (3/4,3/4), (3/4,1/4), (1/4,3/4), (1/4,0), (3/4,1)}, and this configuration can be proven optimal by a big-M MINLP feasibility branch-and-bound that tightens the area lower bound L until the continuous relaxation at every leaf violates at least one constraint sum_{k} a_{ijk} >= L with the McCormick-enforced determinant bound, certifying that no 13-point set achieves minimum triangle area exceeding 1/24."}
